Results.ReviewText:
Great Weber quality and construction - as always.  I have only two complaints about this model:  First - the "inside the cabinet" space for the tank is very difficult to work with, especially for seniors with weakened hand and arm strength.  Secondly:  the four pivoting coasters can also make it difficult to maneuver the grill into tight spaces.  Perhaps locking two of the coasters into one position will help, but I just haven't had an opportunity to try that yet. 

Otherwise - I hope this grill lasts as long and well as my last one that gave me 15 years of dependable service!

My first Weber. I wondered for years if Weber grills were worth the money. If anyone else is thinking that… YES! they undoubtedly are!
It’s a very  high quality grill. Heats much more evenly than my previous two cheaper grills. I won’t go back. 
I love the app as well. I spent some time reading the resources which has increased my grilling skills. Thank you for making a quality product.

Results.ReviewText: I bought this to replace the exact same model I had at my previous house, but elected not to ship with the move to another state.  Works just as well as the old one and am happy with it, except for one thing: either the grill is not getting as hot as it's supposed to or their suggested grilling times are way off.  1 inch filets are supposed to be on the grill from 6-8 minutes.  At 8 minutes in 70 degree weather, they were maybe--maybe--medium rare.  Fine with me, but not with my guests.  I had to grill for 11-12 minutes to get the steaks to medium.  So keep this in mind when using their cooking recommendations.

Results.ReviewText: After receiving the grill packaged in a brand new Weber box and after assembly, there was a bad gas leak at the coupling that attaches to the propane tank. I contacted Weber for a new part but they would not supply one. They said because I bought it through E-Bay they will not honor their warranty even though the grill was brand new. Weber customer service verified the grill came off their assembly line in July 2021 by the serial number included with the grill yet they would not honor the warranty. When I contacted the business I bought the grill from, the return shipping label they provided was to a Home Depot in GA. So even though I bought it on E-Bay, the grill apparently came from a Home Depot. So if you find a good deal on E-Bay for a brand new grill from Weber, beware...they will not honor their warranty. Rather than disassembling the entire grill ,shipping it back and subsequently reassembling a new grill, I bought a regulator and hose for less than $25 to fix the problem. Very disappointed.
Results.Title: Bad Gas Leak Right Out of the Box - No Warranty

Designed to fit on a small patio or balcony, the Spirit E-210 gas grill brings grilling to any home.
